sources.observations: Official roof/site plan identifies10159F321households,10255F303,10350F271,10456F257; floor schedule marks29F refuge and4–20F projecting balconies. This published design is crosschecked against completed photographs.
June2023 completed skyline, woven dark-brown/white facade, coloured projecting balconies, low retail base and elevated garden.
Completed facade award photographs: open white roof-frame extensions, individual blue windows, offset paired-storey frames and sinuous terracotta retail band.

Seoul public building register, snapshot 2026-09-08. Exact parcel and numbered towers identify 192/179.5/164/183 metre legal heights and 59/55/50/56 floors; raw rows and hashes frozen in official-register-source.json.

limits: Reference photographs and site plan support the visible silhouette, palette and repeated architectural language; unseen rear openings and internal floor plans are not surveyed.

Registered heights replace unverified OSM values. Legal height and architectural top may differ; crowns are conservatively contained within registered envelope. Facade members, crown depths and retail heights remain photo-proportion estimates.
Retail frontage is a simplified low-rise interpretation under the user priority; no interiors or exact landscaping.
Shared styles within these four towers follow their actual common development; this recipe must not be applied to unrelated complexes.
reviewCorrections: Rejected first massing: repeated full-face grids obscured broad brown vertical strips seen in BS photographs; split every visible bank into explicit facade fields.
Removed invented full-width refuge belt:29F is in official schedule but completed white-frame facades remain vertically continuous. Only service strips and recessed return vents mark it.
Replaced flat paper-like crown screens with open3D rectangular cages and crossbars; narrowed end windows and deepened crown frames.
Darkened glazing/mineral facade to match BS photographs under daylight; omitted exact hidden-face approval.
